en: Good day, Corbett.  Here's your cheese, fresh made this morning!  And how are things at your shop?
Krang Stonehoof stands astride his training circle at the southeast corner of the village.
%s gestures to the pitcher of water sitting on the edge of the well.
You are terminated.
Oh, my love! No! Don't let me die without you...

No, $n, you did not. I do not fault you, however, as yours is a mind much like mine was as a youth: Impetuous, rebellious, and often without a single coherent thought! Traits I can no longer afford to express.$B$BEnough lamenting. $R, I have a task for you; one that you may not survive.
Tell me the phrase to Tirth's lockbox.
Speak with Lawrence Shneider at Duncan's Textiles around the corner to the left. He is adept at dealing with beginners.
OH NO YOU DIDN'! ITS ON NOW! <PH>
I shall spill your blood, $C!
I have lost the talisman, Falthir. I require a replacement.
Renault...
$n!  Prepare to meet your doom!
Welcome to Camp Mojache, brave $c.  How may I assist you this day?
My mission is compete. I may have some spare supplies if you need any.
Tell me what you want, and make it quick.

Gorzeeki tells me that you have brought him all that he needs for the Bell of Dethmoora, the Wheel of the Black March and the Doomsday Candle.$B$BWell done, $n!  You are almost ready to perform your ritual and bind a dreadsteed!
The Light be with ya, $c. How can I help ya?
So, I found this shackle key...

Greetings, $c - I'm a Commendation Officer acting on behalf of Thunder Bluff.  It is my duty to assist adventurers who have received Horde Commendation Signets.$B$BI accept signets in different quantities, but the most beneficial exchange for you is to hand in a set of ten at once.  I will enter your deeds into our records when you hand in your signets.  As a result, you will earn recognition from Thunder Bluff for your duty and service.
The Stormpike Graveyard is cut into the mountains, across the bridge east of Dun Baldar.$B$BThe Alliance currently controls it.
Help!$B$BIf you get me out of here, I can blow up the door that leads to the chief of Zul'Farrak!
Yeah? Of course I'm a smith. What, you think Dwarves are the only ones worth their weight in anvils? Fine, be that way. Go get a dwarf to help you!
Welcome to flavor country!
Unleash the cavalry!
Barely hit the target that time. Hmmm,... maybe I need to adjust back to the right.
May I bask in your shadow forever!
ZZzzzz....
I'd like to fly to Rut'theran Village.
One day I'll be a real boy.
Take it! This thing is probably more trouble than its worth.
Stand by, $n! To craft a reward of such exquisite quality takes time.
Raze need go home now. Bye, bye, $r.

If you're here for the food, then welcome!  You won't find finer dining in all of Stormwind...or Azeroth!$B$BIf you're here on other matters, then please be brief.  I have a dozen dishes in preparation, and must care for each.
The threads that holds together the abominations of Stratholme are highly sought after by artisan craftsmen: Extremely resilient - nearly unbreakable.
The druid, Kal, often spends his time at the moonwell in Dolanaar.  I am certain he would be able to provide you with the training you require.
By Thaurissan's beard! Slay them!
As was fated a lifetime ago in Karazhan, monster - I come - and with me I bring justice.
Hold, $n!  I'm guarding these barrels, so ... look, but don't touch!
Doctor Herbert Halsey in The Apothecarium where us was born.  Him could sew you back together better like us.
